title: Phase 2：反例搜尋器第三批（Ratajczak）：推翻 A134559 的猜想（4933），另一半證明成立

A134559.proof: 4933 in A005383 but b_4934(134) = 14802 = 6*2467, b_4934(0) = 7404, so gcd(P(4934),4934) = 4934. Lean a134559_counterexample. Least counterexample; 7 below 1.5e5. Converse (solutions lie in A005383) proved on paper.

A322445.proof: a(n)=a(n+1) only 2400 for n <= 1e7 and among all consecutive 47-smooth pairs (< 1.2e12).

A309491.proof: only even solution with n/2 not prime is 8, n <= 1e8.

A008590.proof: Ratajczak parity characterization holds for 2 <= n <= 1e8.

A033235.proof: prime p: b(p) = 1 (mod p) iff p = x^2+55y^2 holds for p <= 1e8.

novelty.note: Elementary; nothing new claimed beyond the counterexample and an easy converse. Web, MathSciNet, zbMATH not searched.
